newsitem.title: UK: Davies Turner opens new Manchester airfreight facility.
newsitem.headline: Davies Turner opens new Manchester airfreight facility.

text.p: Davies Turner Air Cargo said it has opened a new airfreight terminal at Manchester International Airport replacing the previous off-airport facility at Wythenshawe.
Davies Turner is now handling the equivalent of 2000 tonnes a year at Manchester and expects to increase this to 2,500 tonnes by end 1997, a company spokesman told Reuters.

The new 5,000 sq.ft office and dedicated warehouse complex will enable the company to further develop logistic services including order processing, picking and packing and nationwide distribution, northern regional manager, Sue Jamison said in a company statement.
